# Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage

Ghana's government has defended its purchase of a new presidential jet amid criticism over its cost, as many citizens continue to struggle with the high cost of living.

The $60m (£46m) French-made Falcon 6X has sparked political row, with opposition politicians accusing President John Mahama's administration of misplaced priorities. [...]
